high.label: High risk
high.meaning: Top holders funded by the same private wallet hold over 10% of supply in one group, or over 20% across groups. Sift's own paper books refuse to trade above that line.

watch.label: Watch
watch.meaning: Linked groups hold 5% of supply or more but stay under that line. Also used when the only links over the line run through a high-volume wallet (possibly an exchange or a bot) or through a wallet seen behind holders of several tokens.

low.label: Low risk
low.meaning: Linked groups hold under 5% of the supply that could be traced.

incomplete.label: Incomplete
incomplete.meaning: Too many top holders could not be traced to say how much linked groups hold.

definitions.scope: High risk and Watch entries, closed and not void
definitions.outcome: a collapse is a lowest price within 7 days at or below 20% of the entry price, or a token that vanished
definitions.age: Young: the token had traded for 30 days or less when it entered; older: longer
definitions.exit: Sold: the linked wallets' last reading within 7 days is under half their first; held: otherwise
definitions.note: descriptive, not a prediction: selling and falling prices can happen together

definitions.rule: a High risk or Watch entry inside its 7 days whose linked wallets' holdings among the 20 largest accounts fall under half of the first reading, seen between two hourly readings
definitions.counted: entries that entered on or after exit_since and are not void
definitions.outcomes: for each closed warned entry: whether its 7-day price is below the price at the warning (a vanished token is below), the change from the warning price to the 7-day price and to the lowest price after the warning, whether it collapsed, and whether the warning came before the first hourly sample at or below 20% of the entry price
definitions.note: a wallet that left the 20 largest accounts may still hold a little; prices are hourly, so a warning and a crash inside the same hour look simultaneous
